name: aitrends-thumbnail
description: Turn a video script into cinematic YouTube thumbnail options for the What If channel: reads the script, picks the moments worth a poster and stages each as a film still on the aiTrends 3D engine (film light, depth of field, weather, low angle, the channel hero large in the foreground, roster characters reacting), text only where the script needs it; renders 1280x720 JPGs with a picking sheet and checks.
